title: Natural additive RHom map normalized on injective cocycles
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions], $M\in\mathcal A$, and $v=\operatorname{Hom}(M,-)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Put $Rv=v.rightDerivedFunctorPlus$ on $D^+(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] and $S=M[0]\in D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There exist additive homomorphisms $\tau_X^n:H^n(RvX)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(S,X[n])$, natural in $X$. For every bounded below degreewise injective complex $I$ and cocycle $f:M\to I^n$, first pass $f$ to $H^n(vI)$ through the canonical cycles isomorphism and homology projection, then through the inverse cohomology-to-Q isomorphism and the cohomology of the total-derived unit. Its image under $\tau_{QI}^n$ is the localized complex map of $f$, followed by the shifted quotient-to-derived comparison isomorphism on $I$. No bijectivity, no arbitrary resolution roof formula, and no shift coherence is asserted.

proof.text: For a bounded below complex of injectives, send a Hom-complex cocycle from M[0] to its localized shifted map. HomComplexSingle identifies boundaries with null-homotopic maps; hence the map descends additively through the cohomology quotient. Use the invertible total-derived unit to identify its source with H^n(Rv(QI)).

Use the equivalence from the bounded below homotopy category of injective objects to D+ to extend the map: its inverse supplies the injective homotopy representative and its counit transports to the given object. Every derived morphism lifts uniquely to a homotopy class by K-injective localization. The cocycle construction commutes with chain maps, homotopic maps act equally, and naturality of the derived unit proves naturality. The same lifting applied to an arbitrary injective complex gives the stated normalization.

theorem exists_rhom_natural_cocycle_map
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [EnoughInjectives C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} AddCommGrpCat.{v}] (M : C) :
    let V := preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op M)
    let RV := V.rightDerivedFunctorPlus
    let H (n : ℤ) := DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v} n
    let S := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M
    ∃ τ : ∀ (X : DerivedCategory.Plus C) (n : ℤ),
        (H n).obj (RV.obj X) →+ (S ⟶ X.obj⟦n⟧),
      (∀ (X Y : DerivedCategory.Plus C) (g : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℤ)
          (a : (H n).obj (RV.obj X)),
        τ Y n ((H n).map (RV.map g) a) =
          τ X n a ≫ ((DerivedCategory.Plus.ι (C := C)).map g)⟦n⟧') ∧
      (∀ (I : CochainComplex.Plus C) (_hi : ∀ k : ℤ, Injective (I.obj.X k))
          (n : ℤ) (f : M ⟶ I.obj.X n) (hf : f ≫ I.obj.d n (n + 1) = 0),
        let J := (V.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I.obj
        let a := J.homologyπ n ((J.sc n).abCyclesIso.inv
          ⟨f, by
            change f ≫ I.obj.d n ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).next n) = 0
            rw [CochainComplex.next]
            exact hf⟩)
        let b := (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctorObjQIso
          (V.mapCochainComplexPlus.obj I) n).inv a
        let η := V.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient C).obj I)
        τ ((DerivedCategory.Plus.Q (C := C)).obj I) n ((H n).map η b) =
          ShiftedHom.map (Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm
              (Cocycle.fromSingleMk f (zero_add n) (n + 1) rfl hf)) DerivedCategory.Q ≫
            ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso C).hom.app I.obj)⟦n⟧')
